title: Wu-Tang Clan Launches Exclusive SiriusXM Channel Celebrating Their Legacy
summary: Hear classic Wu-Tang anthems, solo projects, exclusive interviews, live performances, and more on The Wu-Tang Clan Channel.
body_markdown:
SiriusXM is celebrating one of hip-hop’s most influential groups with the launch of[The Wu-Tang Clan Channel](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/wu-tang-clan) presented by Rock The Bells Radio, an exclusive pop-up channel honoring the legendary collective’s music, cultural influence, and enduring legacy.


[The Wu-Tang Clan Channel Wu-Tang hits, deep cuts & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogWuTangClanChannel)


Available on the SiriusXM app from November 4 through December 1, the channel features classic Wu-Tang anthems, essential album cuts, iconic solo projects, live performances, exclusive interviews with group members, rare stories behind the music, and special programming available only on SiriusXM.


- **Related:[RZA Hosts Wu Wednesdays Show Every Week on Rock The Bells Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/rza-wu-wednesdays-rock-the-bells-radio)**


The month-long celebration also coincides with Wu-Tang Clan’s Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction and Wu-Tang Clan Day in New York City, which honors the anniversary of the group’s landmark 1993 debut album, *Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers)* .


### **How to Listen to The Wu-Tang Clan Channel**


- [SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogWuTangClanChannel) : November 4–December 1
- [LL COOL J’s Rock The Bells Radio (Ch. 43)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/rock-the-bells-radio) : Special Wu-Wednesdays every Wednesday in November


### **Wu-Wednesdays on Rock The Bells Radio**


Every Wednesday in November, LL COOL J’s Rock The Bells Radio (Ch. 43) will spotlight Wu-Tang Clan’s more than three-decade career with music from the group’s legendary catalog, exclusive commentary, behind-the-scenes insights, and personal reflections on their influence and legacy.


### **Exclusive Wu-Tang Clan Front Row Event**


Wu-Tang Clan members will join host Peter Rosenberg for an exclusive SiriusXM Front Row Q&A in front of a live audience at SiriusXM’s Los Angeles studios on Thursday, November 12.


The full conversation will air Friday, November 13, at 6pm ET on both Rock The Bells Radio and The Wu-Tang Clan Channel, with on-demand listening available afterward on the SiriusXM app.


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can also enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to attend the special Front Row event.[Enter here for a chance to win](https://www.siriusxm.com/wutangclanfrontrowblog) .
